form_cues: RIGHT arm only; keep the left arm resting and clear of moving parts.
Chest stays on the pad. No left-hand handle grip, seat grip, or counter-bracing.
Use only a machine that supports safe independent one-arm rowing; ask staff to check it.
Pull and return smoothly with an easy load; do not rotate or lean away from the chest pad.
notes: Conditional right-side variation during left-forearm protection, not clearance for left-arm pulling. No starting weight is assumed. A suitable machine has not been confirmed at this gym. Prefer selectorized equipment; staff must help with setup or plates if needed. The reference photo/video may show bilateral work; keep the left hand off all handles. Do not substitute an unsupported cable row, dumbbell row, rower, or pulldown.
instructions: Ask staff to confirm independent right-arm operation and a stable chest-supported position without left-arm assistance. Skip if the machine instructions require the other hand on a handle or support, or if entry and exit need the left arm.

Adjust the seat and chest pad with staff help as needed so the right handle is reachable without lifting your chest off the pad. Select a light comfortable resistance and record the actual weight; never use the left arm to load or unload plates.
Place your feet securely and rest the left arm comfortably in your lap or on a non-moving support away from the mechanism. Do not grip the unused handle or brace through the left hand or elbow.

Pull the right handle toward your torso with a controlled elbow bend while your chest stays on the pad. Keep your torso facing forward and stop well before straining, leaving at least four good repetitions in reserve.

Return slowly without twisting or reaching beyond a comfortable position. Settle the machine before exiting. Stop for left-forearm symptoms or any need for left-arm support; omit the movement next time if symptoms are worse later that day or the next morning.
